category.reason: MEGA is named directly in the instruction and visible Brand filter; locate its selection control.

instruction.en: Select MEGA in the Brand filter to view its Charizard products.
instruction.zh: 在 Brand 品牌筛选栏中选择 MEGA，查看该品牌的喷火龙商品。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the original English instruction. The original instruction described a company known for building-block toys and figures without naming MEGA; that description neither uniquely identifies the brand nor has an explicit explanation in the screenshot. Rewrote both instructions to select MEGA in the Brand filter for Charizard products, removing the dependency on toy-brand background knowledge. The target remains the MEGA selection control, with the original groundTruth. Changed category.item from Reasoning to Basic Element and updated category.reason to reflect direct matching of the named brand to its visible filter option.
